steps.en: Install one binary, start herdr where the work lives
steps.zh: 装一个二进制，在工作所在处启动 herdr

steps.en: Open a workspace per repo, split a pane, launch your agents
steps.zh: 每个仓库开一个 workspace，切出 pane，照常跑你的 agent

steps.en: Detects each recognized agent and badges it working / blocked / done / idle
steps.zh: 识别每个 agent，打上 working/blocked 等标记

steps.en: Tells you when an agent stops and needs an answer
steps.zh: agent 停下来要人回答时，直接通知你

steps.en: Walk away — detach; the server and all panes keep running
steps.zh: 走人——脱离；server 和所有 pane 继续跑

steps.en: Come back and reattach; the same processes are still there
steps.zh: 回来重新附着；还是原来那批进程

value.en: No more window-hunting to find the stuck agent — and a dropped SSH or closed lid no longer kills hours of agent work
value.zh: 不用挨个窗口找卡住的 agent——断线、合盖也杀不掉跑了几小时的活

sources: README install section (curl -fsSL https://herdr.dev/install.sh | sh; 'then start it where the work lives: herdr'; 'ctrl+b q detaches, herdr reattaches')

README bullets ('detach without stopping work' — background server keeps terminals running; 'never hunt for the stuck one' — every pane marked working, blocked, or idle; herdr says so when an agent needs an answer)
docs/agent-automation 'Three primitives' (verbatim: herdr workspace create --cwd ~/project --label api --no-focus; creation prints JSON)
docs/concepts 'Agent' (states blocked/working/done/idle/unknown; detection from foreground processes, screen manifests, optional integrations)
